Packet 3's stopping condition has been satisfied, and NF-3 is the next unproven promise that unblocks honest completion of NF-1, NF-4, and the self-hosting gate.
reviewNotes: Revision 2 corrects duplicate statements to canonical wording. Stage only. No canonical additions are proposed: INT-2 is byte-identical to INT-1, and all potentially applicable decisions, assumption, inferred risk, objective/work, and revision-record question map to DEC-7, DEC-8, DEC-9, ASM-3, RSK-5, NF-2, and NF-8. There is no true conflict with NF-3: the exclusions and stopping condition are explicitly Packet-3-bounded, and canonical context says Packet 3 is complete enough to advance.
